name: Default
shortDescription: Gerrit Code Review server for Git-based code review, behind an nginx proxy that handles sign-in with HTTP basic auth.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated password stored after {PLAIN} in the gerrit.htpasswd mount. The first account to sign in becomes the Gerrit administrator, so sign in as admin right after the first start. Add one user:{PLAIN}password line per user to that mount and redeploy.
Outgoing email is not configured, so users cannot confirm email addresses. Set the [sendemail] section in /var/gerrit/etc/gerrit.config, or have an administrator add user emails through the REST API.
The SSH port 29418 is not published. Use Git over HTTPS with the HTTP password generated under Settings > HTTP Credentials.
